translations.en.sahih: Woe to those who give less [than due],
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the defrauders:
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan besarlah bagi orang-orang yang curang

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
translations.en.pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
translations.en.yusufali: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang apabila menerima takaran dari orang lain mereka minta dipenuhi,

transliteration: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon

translations.en.sahih: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
translations.en.pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
translations.en.yusufali: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila mereka menakar atau menimbang untuk orang lain, mereka mengurangi.

translations.en.sahih: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
translations.en.pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
translations.en.yusufali: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
translations.id.indonesian: Tidaklah orang-orang itu menyangka, bahwa sesungguhnya mereka akan dibangkitkan,

translations.en.sahih: For a tremendous Day -
translations.en.pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,
translations.en.yusufali: On a Mighty Day,
translations.id.indonesian: pada suatu hari yang besar,

translations.en.sahih: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
translations.en.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.en.yusufali: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) hari (ketika) manusia berdiri menghadap Tuhan semesta alam?

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali jangan curang, karena sesungguhnya kitab orang yang durhaka tersimpan dalam sijjin.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah sijjin itu?

translations.en.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
translations.en.pickthall: A written record.
translations.en.yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
translations.id.indonesian: (Ialah) kitab yang bertulis.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan,

translations.en.sahih: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
translations.en.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
translations.en.yusufali: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang mendustakan hari pembalasan.

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

translations.en.sahih: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
translations.en.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
translations.en.yusufali: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidak ada yang mendustakan hari pembalasan itu melainkan setiap orang yang melampaui batas lagi berdosa,

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.en.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
translations.id.indonesian: yang apabila dibacakan kepadanya ayat-ayat Kami, ia berkata: "Itu adalah dongengan orang-orang yang dahulu"

arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

translations.en.sahih: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak (demikian), sebenarnya apa yang selalu mereka usahakan itu menutupi hati mereka.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak, sesungguhnya mereka pada hari itu benar-benar tertutup dari (rahmat) Tuhan mereka.

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
translations.en.yusufali: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar masuk neraka.

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

translations.en.sahih: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
translations.en.pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
translations.en.yusufali: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, dikatakan (kepada mereka): "Inilah azab yang dahulu selalu kamu dustakan".

arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak, sesungguhnya kitab orang-orang yang berbakti itu (tersimpan) dalam 'Illiyyin.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah 'Illiyyin itu?

translations.en.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
translations.en.pickthall: A written record,
translations.en.yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) kitab yang bertulis,

translations.en.sahih: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
translations.en.yusufali: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: yang disaksikan oleh malaikat-malaikat yang didekatkan (kepada Allah).

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang yang berbakti itu benar-benar berada dalam kenikmatan yang besar (surga),

translations.en.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
translations.en.pickthall: On couches, gazing,
translations.en.yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
translations.id.indonesian: mereka (duduk) di atas dipan-dipan sambil memandang.

translations.en.sahih: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
translations.en.yusufali: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
translations.id.indonesian: Kamu dapat mengetahui dari wajah mereka kesenangan mereka yang penuh kenikmatan.

translations.en.sahih: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
translations.en.pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
translations.en.yusufali: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka diberi minum dari khamar murni yang dilak (tempatnya),

arabic: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

translations.en.sahih: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
translations.en.pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
translations.en.yusufali: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
translations.id.indonesian: laknya adalah kesturi; dan untuk yang demikian itu hendaknya orang berlomba-lomba.

translations.en.sahih: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
translations.en.pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
translations.en.yusufali: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan campuran khamar murni itu adalah dari tasnim,

translations.en.sahih: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
translations.en.pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
translations.en.yusufali: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) mata air yang minum daripadanya orang-orang yang didekatkan kepada Allah.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
translations.en.yusufali: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa, adalah mereka yang menertawakan orang-orang yang beriman.

translations.en.sahih: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
translations.en.pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;
translations.en.yusufali: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila orang-orang yang beriman lalu di hadapan mereka, mereka saling mengedip-ngedipkan matanya.

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

translations.en.sahih: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
translations.en.pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
translations.en.yusufali: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila orang-orang yang berdosa itu kembali kepada kaumnya, mereka kembali dengan gembira.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

translations.en.sahih: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
translations.en.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
translations.en.yusufali: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila mereka melihat orang-orang mukmin, mereka mengatakan: "Sesungguhnya mereka itu benar-benar orang-orang yang sesat",

translations.en.sahih: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
translations.en.yusufali: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
translations.id.indonesian: padahal orang-orang yang berdosa itu tidak dikirim untuk penjaga bagi orang-orang mukmin.

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

translations.en.sahih: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
translations.en.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
translations.en.yusufali: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pada hari ini, orang-orang yang beriman menertawakan orang-orang kafir,

translations.en.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
translations.en.pickthall: On high couches, gazing.
translations.en.yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
translations.id.indonesian: mereka (duduk) di atas dipan-dipan sambil memandang.

arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon

translations.en.sahih: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
translations.en.pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
translations.en.yusufali: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir telah diberi ganjaran terhadap apa yang dahulu mereka kerjakan.
